Kuuya (father) |live=yes |livedebut=''[[A Pocketful of Adventures]]'' |liveactor={{jwp|クラージュキッズ|Towa Watanabe}} }} '''Sora Karasawa''' (Japanese: '''唐沢空 ''' ''Karasawa Sora'') is a supporting character of ''[[A Pocketful of Adventures]]''. He is portrayed by {{jwp|クラージュキッズ|Towa Watanabe}}. ==History== [[File:Madoka and Sora.png|250px|left|thumb|Sora playing Pokémon with Madoka Akagi]] In [[PPA02]], Sora found Madoka playing Pokémon Red while having dinner at his mother's restaurant. After a brief introduction, he showed Madoka how the most [[Generation IX|recent games]] in the franchise were, revealing that he had played them all before. Shortly afterwards, while they were playing, Sora taught Madoka about the [[Obedience]] of Traded Pokémon and how [[Badge]]s help in the relationship between Pokémon and Trainer. In [[PPA03]], while Madoka was having dinner with [[Yoko Meguro]], Sora asked Madoka how she was doing in the game and she showed him her [[Party]] in Pokémon Red. In [[PPA04]], Sora tried to teach Madoka how to capture a {{p|Kangaskhan}} in the [[Kanto Safari Zone]], before leaving he made a connection between the Safari Zone [[Baoba|Warden]] and good deeds to explain to her how to proceed in the game. In [[PPA06]], Sora watched Madoka's battle against [[Kageaki Hiyama]], during the battle, he was able to understand Hiyama's strategy quickly. ==Character== Despite being quite young, Sora knows a lot about the universe of Pokémon games, explaining some concepts to Madoka. Unlike her, Sora is very up to date with the latest games and plays [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]] on his [[Nintendo Switch]]. As his friendship with Madoka grew, Madoka began to affectionately call him "master"(Japanese:).
